article.story: ANNAPOLIS, Md. -- — Donovan Draper scored 15 points as Navy beat Division III member Rosemont 70-23 on Sunday. Draper added six rebounds and three steals for the Midshipmen (8-5). Aidan Kehoe added nine points while going 3 of 4 and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line and also had 10 rebounds. Brandon Moore led the Ravens with seven points. Navy took the lead with 19:43 remaining in the first half and did not trail again. Draper led the team with nine points for a 35-12 advantage at the break. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
